reviews.title: Perfect motherboard
reviews.comment:
Works perfectly
Has great durability.
As I bought it for nearly half price, I also got great price to performance. Heat sinks are fine, easy to install, manage and etc.
Has many I/O ports, 5x M.2 NVME, 4x SATA and etc. which makes it way better.
reviews.author: Raffi Makhmuryan

reviews.title: Muy bien
reviews.comment: Fácil de configurar y los materiales de construcción se ven muy bien
reviews.author: Edwin

reviews.title: I was let down and this was my second one.
reviews.comment: Very unhappy.  Boots slow.  Doesn't wake up from sleeping.  I have to unplug it from the wall and wait a minute and plug it back in before it boots. I tried it with a second power supply to see if that was the problem.  I loved it until this problem took over. Being able to put all the hard drives in was amazing.
reviews.author: Nina

reviews.title: Operational but over priced
reviews.comment: Very attractive board.  Could be cheaper.  Have had no operational problems.
reviews.author: I Build For A Living
